text:
Maya: Quick sync  Optimize toolkit scope needs trimming for this sprint. Propose: ship eval-triggered alerts + lightweight quantization recommendations; defer persistent KV cache tuning and full adaptive batching. Customers asking for alerts first (Acme, NudgeAI, FinWare pilot).

Aj: Adaptive batching is infra-heavy. Alerts + quant recs => MVP in ~2 eng-weeks.

Zach: Alerts unblock rollback/rollout actions. +1.

Dena: Acceptance criteria idea for alerts: webhook delivery median <5s, false positives <10% on our eval suite, docs + runbook. For quant recs: provide top-3 model+quant options with estimated cost & quality deltas.

Maya: Canary plan: internal -> 2 pilots -> GA. Gate = pilot signoff + 2w stability telemetry.

Aj: API sketch: POST /api/v1/evals/{id}/alerts {"threshold":0.8,"destinations":["ops","slack:#alerts"],"mode":"sampled"}. Will use existing webhook dispatcher.

Sam: If batching is deferred, leave feature flag hooks so we can flip simple batch params later.

Zach: Suggest "heuristics" stretch: recommend batch sizes/timeouts per route instead of runtime changes.

Maya: Prioritize alerts + quant recs; heuristics as stretch if no blockers.

Dena: Launch docs should include example alert payload, troubleshooting, SLOs. Example payload: {"eval_id":"eval-2026-03-19-01","metric":"concordance","value":0.62,"threshold":0.75,"samples":["promptA","promptB"]}.

Aj: Blockers: small evals table schema change + webhook retry plumbing (we have lib). ETA Fri EOD for schema.

release-bot: Deploy window scheduled 2026-03-24 02:00-03:00 UTC.

Sam: I'll draft pilot one-pager (what triggers an alert, remediation, expected noise) by Thu.

Maya: Risk: quant recs might confuse customers if we show aggressive quant levels w/o quality delta. Dena to own expected-quality column.

Zach: Ops request: include telemetry tags (customer_id, model_version, route) in alert payload.

Aj: Will add tags.

Maya: Decision: ship eval-triggered alerts + lightweight quant recs. Heuristic batching = stretch. Defer KV tuning. Gates: pilot signoff + 2w telemetry. I'll update roadmap and product board.
